provenance.declared_source: one serialization measured on 2026-10-10 with tenseal 0.3.17 (CROSS_LANGUAGE_DECISIONS item 6); reference re-measurement over 400 ciphertexts: mean 432453, min 432278, max 432653, std 64
provenance.note: the SEAL serializer compresses the ciphertext, so the size varies with the ciphertext bytes (about 0.05 percent); the formulas charge the declared measured value
provenance.parameters: poly_modulus_degree 8192, plain_modulus 68720050177, TenSEAL default coefficient modulus

conventions.argmax: argmax_k* is the tournament with index, release excluded (RELEASE_FINAL adds one message of 8 bytes per row and one round)
conventions.mask: formulas price the unmasked row; a public mask only removes pairwise comparisons
conventions.material: per-party bytes by material type; drelu = drelu_p1 * drelu_p1_bytes + drelu_p2 * drelu_p2_bytes; kary_select and beaver 24 per element; matrix_triple and wmask_mask 8 per element
conventions.payload_bytes: raw opened bytes over both directions: 16 per opened ring element (DReLU, faithful truncation, ring-to-field and linear openings), 32 per Beaver element, 8 per one-way ring element, ct_bytes per BFV ciphertext
conventions.shape: linear, embedding, matmul: X (n x d_in) W (d_in x d_out); install: one d_in x d_out matrix; gelu, trunc_faithful, ring_to_field, a2h_exact: n * d_in elements; softmax, layernorm, argmax: n rows of length d_in
conventions.tournament: fused k-ary tournament of party.Party._tournament: per node of g members g(g-1)/2 DReLUs without payload; a node of 2 members one Beaver select per output value; a node of g >= 3 members g-1 payload DReLUs per output value; the index is an output value on every level after the first; 2 rounds per level

framing.rule: every message is one frame: an 8-byte length prefix plus a typed-value header; frame_bytes is the framing of a frame carrying one 1-D uint64 array under the binding wire codec of API.md (8 prefix + tag + dtype + ndim + one u64 dimension); every further array dimension adds dim_bytes; payload is the raw little-endian element data
